title: MATLAB learning-by-teaching sessions with MatlabTutee
summary: Students teach MATLAB concepts to an LLM that simulates a novice learner, explaining concepts, examples, and code over repeated sessions. The activity uses teaching as the assessed learning process and compares the teachable agent with a human novice persona and an expert GPT-4 assistant.

sources.title: Playing Dumb to Get Smart: Creating and Evaluating an LLM-based Teachable Agent within University Computer Science Classes

locator.section: 4 Developing an LLM as a learning partner

sources.evidence_quote: four studies that explored how the understanding of programming concepts by students evolved

assessment.summary: Teach a learning partner MATLAB topics including arrays, conditionals, loops, and file analysis.
student_actions: Explain MATLAB concepts and provide examples.
Answer the partner's questions and correct misunderstandings.
Reflect on knowledge and teaching after each session.

student_role.description: Students taught GPT-4-based MatlabTutee or interacted with MatlabGPT in study conditions.
